description: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets per year, separated by the number of data sources used (legend titled “Data sources” with blue bars labeled “1” and orange bars labeled “2+”). The horizontal axis contains the categories as years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order and is labeled “Year.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Number of datasets,” shown on a linear scale with tick marks at regular 20-unit intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100) and values extending a bit above 100. For each year, two adjacent bars are shown: a blue bar for “1” source and an orange bar for “2+” sources. Approximate bar heights are: 2012 (blue 0, orange ~2), 2013 (blue ~2, orange 0), 2014 (blue ~3, orange 0), 2015 (blue ~1, orange ~2), 2016 (blue ~10, orange ~3), 2017 (blue ~22, orange ~6), 2018 (blue ~30, orange ~18), 2019 (blue ~46, orange ~19), 2020 (blue ~87, orange ~43), 2021 (blue ~112, orange ~47), and 2022 (blue ~30, orange ~7). The bars are grouped by year (side-by-side rather than stacked), there is no visible sorting beyond chronological order, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the legend.
